post.title: DigitalEDGE 2024: A Successful Gathering of Industry Leaders
post.content:
25th Sep 2024,

DigitalEDGE 2024, hosted at the Hyatt Place Hotel, brought together over 100 CTOs andCIOs, thanks to the collaborative efforts of Vatsin Technology, Microsoft, and Redington.The event featured inspiring keynotes from Mr. Sumit Sethi, along with engaging sessionsled by industry experts Ms. Sanya Duggal , Mr Sri Nandan Rao and Mr. Bheem Singh.

Mr.Sumit Sethi, from Vatsin Technology, shared insights on how MSME businesses in Indiaare rapidly adopting cloud technology and ERP solutions to drive operational efficiency andgrowth. According to Sumit, the shift to cloud-based platforms has empowered MSMEs tostreamline their processes, reduce costs, and access real-time data from anywhere, enablingthem to compete on a larger scale. He emphasized the importance of ERP systems likeMicrosoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, which provide these businesses with an integratedsolution to manage everything from finance and inventory to customer relationships. Byleveraging cloud technology and ERP, MSMEs are not only modernizing their operations butalso preparing for future growth in an increasingly digital economy.

Ms.Sanya Duggal from Microsoft shared three key insights on how innovation, particularlythrough generative AI, can transform businesses. She emphasized the power of generativeAI, which is revolutionizing how organizations operate. Tools like Copilot, powered byMicrosoft, are enabling businesses to drive efficiency and creativity. There are a significantnumber of organizations already leveraging its potential to gain competitive advantages.Additionally, Sanya highlighted the importance of data integration, noting that consolidateddata across platforms, helps harness the full potential for businesses. Finally, she addressedthe need for maximizing investments in technology and giving returns to the business.

Mr.Bheem Singh from Microsoft delivered an in-depth presentation on Microsoft Dynamics365 Business Central, showcasing its ability to connect finance, sales, service, andoperations teams through a comprehensive business management solution. He highlightedhow businesses can harness the power of AI with Microsoft Copilot, a platform trusted byover 40,000 small and medium-sized enterprises and named “Best ERP System” by ForbesAdvisor in 2024. The discussion also touched on the potential of Microsoft Fabric for AIinnovation, with many attendees expressing interest in leveraging AI for their data estates.

Sri Nandan Rao from Microsoft shared his insights on the transformative potential ofMicrosoft Fabric, a powerful platform that unifies and optimizes data across anorganization’s entire data estate. In a discussion centered on data and AI strategy, Sri Nandan emphasized how Microsoft Fabric acts as a critical foundation for organizations looking tointegrate AI into their business processes. By seamlessly connecting and transformingdisparate data sources, Fabric allows companies to break down data silos, creating a unifiedplatform where data can flow freely and be harnessed to its full potential.

In conclusion, DigitalEdge 2024 provided a transformative platform where industry leadersshared groundbreaking insights into the role of innovation, generative AI, and dataintegration in driving business success. The event showcased how technologies likeMicrosoft Copilot, cloud solutions, and integrated platforms like Business Central arerevolutionizing the way organizations, especially SMBs, operate in today’s fast-evolving
digital landscape. As companies continue to navigate this transformation, the key takeawayremains clear; embracing innovation and investing in the right technologies are essential forstaying competitive and future-ready. DigitalEdge 2024 reaffirmed that businesses willing toadapt and leverage these advancements will be the ones leading the way into a moreconnected, efficient, and innovative future. A key partner in driving this transformation is Vatsin Technology, a trusted Microsoft Certified Partner. Vatsin Technology specializes inimplementing Microsoft ERP Software, helping businesses streamline their operations andleverage the full potential of cloud technology.
